column1: # OCR-MODELS-2026-10-04: open OCR models on this Mac (M3 Pro, 18 GB), ocr-lab-setup round 1 sessions 1-2.
# EIGHT MODELS FIT, nine builds (peak under 12 GB, exit 0, recall >= 0.5 on both pages; some reads stopped at a cap,
# see `why`): glm-ocr, deepseek-ocr-2 (--no-remote-code), hunyuanocr, qwen3.5-2b, qwen3.5-4b, lightonocr-2-1b at
# --max-side 1540, chandra-ocr-2 (oQ8 MLX and GGUF Q4_K_M), surya-ocr-2 through its own package (surya-ocr-2-pkg).
# qwen3.5-9b tripped the guard once (swap) while the guard's refusals were reporting about 5.9 GB reclaimable; one try
# left. Not run, reasons in `why`: teleocr, navidc-ocr, dots.ocr-1.5.
# Every run went through ops/ocrlab/run-guarded.sh (12 GB, critical pressure, swap +2 GB) via try-mlx.sh (surya-ocr-2-pkg by hand, see its note), MLX through
# mlx-vlm 0.7.4 or llama.cpp for GGUF, greedy decoding. Pages, PDFKit renders at 300 dpi: "ordinary" = Noble_1977
# America by design p104 (602-word transcript), "newspaper" = 1931 Helena Daily Independent p1 (about 5,500 words),
# whole page and as the truth set's 13 overlapping crops (each about 1850x1960 px, sized for Gemini: above several
# models' input caps, e.g. PaddleOCR-VL's 1.0 MP, which is why it reads them badly; ocr-bakeoff should cut smaller crops).
# Peaks are MB, the larger of summed RSS and `footprint` (RSS alone saw 30 MB of a 3 GB MLX array). Seconds are the
# model's read time after load for MLX; for GGUF they include a model load per crop. read-mlx.py and read-gguf.py stop
# a read at 600 s, so both chandra builds' crop figures are of a partial read. recall/precision are ROUGH bag-of-words
# figures against the truth transcript (ops/ocrlab/rough-recall.py), a sanity check that a model read the page, NOT
# ocr-bakeoff's score. Vision on the same inputs, from the truth set's own readings: ordinary 0.948/0.979; newspaper
# fits = peak under 12 GB, exit 0 and recall >= 0.5 on the ordinary page and the newspaper crops; precision and speed do
# not decide it (the owner dropped the 90 s rule on 2026-10-04; of the fitting builds only deepseek-ocr-2, cut at max_tokens, read the crops
# in under 130 s). Three whole-page newspaper runs tripped the swap limit with 5-8 GB footprints and the rest looped, so
# later candidates read only the crops. The guard tripped six times, once each on glm-ocr, lightonocr, deepseek-ocr-2,
# qwen3.5-2b, dots.mocr and qwen3.5-9b; no model tripped twice and nothing crashed.
